hook: You're not bad at trading. You're just using the wrong tools.
script_lines: Most traders lose because they're staring at charts at 2am, running on caffeine and hope.
They miss setups. They chase candles. They blow accounts.
Their systems scan thousands of tickers. Spot patterns in seconds. Flag entries before the crowd notices.
It's not magic. It's math running while you can't.
The market doesn't care how hard you work. It rewards who sees first.
You're trading a 2024 game with 2010 tools. That's the problem.
